name: muse
description: MUSE — Music Mood Intelligence & Recommendation Database System (BTech CSE DBMS project)

scripts.setup: npm run db:setup && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.db:workbench: node backend/scripts/build-workbench-sql.js && node backend/scripts/build-erd-sql.js && node backend/scripts/build-er-simple-sql.js && node backend/scripts/build-er-simple-sql.js --plain && node backend/scripts/build-er-simple-sql.js --all --plain && node backend/scripts/build-data-sql.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:web && npm run test:sql && npm run build
scripts.docs:erd: node backend/scripts/erd/extract-schema.js && python3 backend/scripts/erd/build_erd.py && python3 backend/scripts/erd/render.py && python3 backend/scripts/erd/check_docs.py && python3 backend/scripts/erd/build_core.py && python3 backend/scripts/erd/build_chen.py && python3 backend/scripts/erd/build_korth.py && python3 backend/scripts/erd/build_eer.py && python3 backend/scripts/erd/build_phase1_report.py
scripts.db:phase2: node backend/scripts/build-phase2-sql.js && node backend/scripts/test-phase2-sql.js && python3 backend/scripts/erd/build_phase2_report.py && node backend/scripts/export-table-structure.js --load
scripts.phase3:report: python3 phase3/run_query_tests.py && python3 phase3/capture_screenshots.py && python3 phase3/build_phase3_report.py
